svg.title: Measured cost of OS turns versus the same tokens on one large model
svg.desc: Two windows. Window A, 2026-09-24 to 2026-10-04, 607 priced turns: actual 414 dollars, same tokens on Opus 5.5 629 dollars, on Opus 5 1,181 dollars. Window B, from 2026-09-28 when three-tier routing went live, 222 priced turns: actual 344, Opus 5.5 450, Opus 5 863.
